request: Make a 15 to 25 second motion promo for LitGrok, the way a pro typography motion artist would cut a reel: what a person types, what appears on screen, and what they get.
pathReason: The film has to show a drawn terminal, a step rail, a status row and a handoff file, which is more than words can carry.
idea: A session ignites, moves through four typed routes, and hands a lit document to the next terminal so nothing is lost when the window closes.
audience: Developers who use Grok Build and are deciding whether to add a working method on top of it.
channel: The GitHub README of the LitGrok repository, watched inline with the sound off, or opened as an MP4 with the sound on.
formatReason: A README hero sits in a wide column and the MP4 link opens on desktop players, so the master is 1920 by 1080.

beats.purpose: Opening motif: the LitGrok block mark ignites from a dim outline to its three brand colours.
beats.onScreen: The pinned block mark at left, dim at frame one, then a flame front sweeps it into orange, lime and cream while a warm glow and embers rise behind it.
beats.motion: Diagonal ignition front with a brief white-hot edge, glow swelling behind it, embers drifting up.
beats.sound: Soft pulse under a rising pad, then a hit on the moment the mark is fully lit.

beats.purpose: Lockup: the name and the host it is made for.
beats.onScreen: LitGrok in heavy Archivo beside the mark, with For Grok Build under it.
beats.motion: Letters rise through a mask one after another, the kicker fades in, the mark holds its glow.
beats.sound: Pad holds, pulse continues, a small rise into the cut.

beats.purpose: Set piece one: what a person types and what appears.
beats.onScreen: A terminal window with the prompt slash litwork build a to-do list, the LIT IGNITED activation line in the orange to cyan gradient with drawn flames, and a three-item checklist ticking off. The headline Say what you want built sits at right.
beats.motion: The mark shrinks into the top-left corner, the window springs up from below, the prompt types out, the activation line wipes in, the check marks draw on.
beats.sound: A hit on the cut, keys-like ticks on the typing, a bell on the activation line.

beats.purpose: Set piece two: four typed routes, one per step.
beats.onScreen: A rail with four nodes named Plan, Build, Verify and Hand off, each with a one-line descriptor, while the terminal narrows to a prompt bar that types each route in turn.
beats.motion: The window morphs into a slim bar, a spark runs along the rail and lights each node, the headline A route for every step slides in through a mask.
beats.sound: A hit on the cut, a pulse accent as each node lights, a rise into the next cut.

beats.purpose: Peak detail: the optional status row that shows which skill is lit.
beats.onScreen: One large row in the terminal: LIT, grok, the model and the context percentage, then it switches to LIT IGNITED with the skill name in the gradient, and the context number steps up.
beats.motion: The bar zooms into the row, the idle label flips to the active label with a spark, the number steps twice.
beats.sound: A hit on the cut, a bright accent on the flip, pad opens up.

beats.purpose: Set piece three: the handoff that lets the next session continue.
beats.onScreen: Session one writes a HANDOFF file with Built, Checked and Remains, goes dark, and the file travels to a fresh terminal that reads it. The headline Leave the next step with the project sits above.
beats.motion: The row window shrinks to a left card, the document is written line by line, a spark carries it along an arc to the right card, which wakes and types the read line.
beats.sound: A hit on the cut, a rise as the file travels, a soft chord as the right window wakes.

beats.purpose: Resolve: everything returns to the mark, the promise and the install line.
beats.onScreen: The mark lit again at left, Keep the work lit. in large type, and the install command in a slim terminal line below.
beats.motion: Both cards collapse to a spark that opens an iris into the mark, the tagline rises through a mask, the command types, then everything holds still.
beats.sound: A hit on the cut, then a closing cadence that rings out over the hold.

subject.name: LitGrok
specifics: Adds a plan, build, verify and hand-off way of working to Grok Build sessions through skills, a project rule and hooks that live in the project's .grok folder.
Each step is a typed route: slash lit-plan, slash start-work, slash review-work and slash lit-handoff, and an activated reply opens with the LIT IGNITED line.
An optional status row shows the skill that is lit, the model and the context used, and a handoff file lets the next session pick up the checked result and the next step.

typePlan.hierarchy: Archivo 900 headlines in cream with one orange word first, Archivo 700 node names second, Archivo 400 descriptors third, Meslo for everything the terminal prints.

palette.role: Cream, type and the mark body
Middle stop of the status-row gradient only
End stop of the status-row gradient only

sound.plan: A generated bed at 120 BPM in A minor: a low pad that swells with the ignition, a steady bell pulse under the terminal beats, accents on every cut, and a cadence that resolves home during the final hold.

lines: Writes the plan and its checks
Reviews the change and its evidence
Glance down. See what is lit.
Optional status row: skill, model, context.
Leave the next step with the project.
The next session reads it and continues.

inventions: The copy lines, written from the README's own wording for the routes, the status row and the handoff.
The sample prompt, checklist words and file layout shown in the terminals are illustrations built from strings the README and hooks print; the drawn flames stand in for the flame emoji.
ambition: Kinetic type with a clear three-level hierarchy, one continuous terminal object that morphs from window to bar to status row to two cards so every cut is a match cut, real ignition colours, and a final hold that lands on the mark and the promise.
